name: Titanium.XML.Node
summary: A single node in the [Document](api:Titanium.XML.Document) tree.
description:
Implements the [DOM Level 2 API](https://www.w3.org/TR/DOM-Level-2-Core/core.html#ID-1950641247)
on Android and iOS.

Note that on iOS, only [Element](api:Titanium.XML.Element) nodes are mutable. This means
that the methods `appendChild`, `insertBefore`, `removeChild`, and
`replaceChild` only work on `Element` objects. If one of these methods is called on
another type of node, it throws an exception.

properties.name: ATTRIBUTE_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify an
[Attr](api:Titanium.XML.Attr) node.

properties.name: attributes
properties.summary: A map of this node's attributes.
properties.description:
As defined by the DOM specification, only [Element](api:Titanium.XML.Element) nodes have attributes.
For all other node types, this property is always `null`.

properties.name: CDATA_SECTION_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify a
[CDATASection](api:Titanium.XML.CDATASection) node.

properties.name: childNodes
properties.summary: A [Titanium.XML.NodeList](api:Titanium.XML.NodeList) of this node's children.

properties.name: COMMENT_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify a
[Comment](api:Titanium.XML.Comment) node.

properties.name: DOCUMENT_FRAGMENT_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify a
[DocumentFragment](api:Titanium.XML.DocumentFragment) node.

properties.name: DOCUMENT_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify a
[Document](api:Titanium.XML.Document) node.

properties.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify a
[DocumentType](api:Titanium.XML.DocumentType) node.

properties.name: ELEMENT_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify an
[Element](api:Titanium.XML.Element) node.

properties.name: ENTITY_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify an
[Entity](api:Titanium.XML.Entity) node.

properties.name: ENTITY_REFERENCE_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify an
[EntityReference](api:Titanium.XML.EntityReference) node.

properties.name: firstChild
properties.summary: This node's first child.

properties.name: lastChild
properties.summary: This node's last child.

properties.name: localName
properties.summary: Local part of the qualified name of this node.
properties.description:
The local part of the qualified name that comes after the colon. That is,
the name without the namespace prefix.

properties.name: namespaceURI
properties.summary: Namespace URI of this node.

properties.name: nextSibling
properties.summary: This node's next sibling.

properties.name: nodeName
properties.summary: Name of this node.
properties.description:
Certain node types have constant values defined by the DOM specification:

* Text node: `#text`
* Comment node: `#comment`
* CDATA section node: `#cdata-section`
* Document node: `#document`
* Document fragment node: `#document-fragment`

properties.name: nodeType
properties.summary:
This node's type. One of `ELEMENT_NODE`, `ATTRIBUTE_NODE`, `TEXT_NODE`, `CDATA_SECTION_NODE`,
`ENTITY_REFERENCE_NODE`, `ENTITY_NODE`, `PROCESSING_INSTRUCTION_NODE`, `COMMENT_NODE`,
`DOCUMENT_NODE`, `DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODE`, `DOCUMENT_FRAGMENT_NODE`, `NOTATION_NODE`.

properties.name: nodeValue
properties.summary: Content (value) of this node.
properties.description:
As defined in the DOM specification, the node value is always `null` for
Document, DocumentFragment, DocumentType, Element, Entity, EntityReference, and
Notation nodes.

properties.name: NOTATION_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify a
[Notation](api:Titanium.XML.Notation) node.

properties.name: ownerDocument
properties.summary: This node's owning document.
properties.description:
Note that a node always has an owning document, even if it is not part of the
document tree.

For more on node ownership, see [ownerDocument issues](https://www.w3.org/DOM/faq.html#ownerdoc)
in the W3C DOM FAQ.

properties.name: parentNode
properties.summary: This node's parent node.

properties.name: prefix
properties.summary: Namespace prefix of this node.
properties.description: Read-only on iOS, read-write on other platforms.

properties.name: previousSibling
properties.summary: This node's previous sibling.

properties.name: PROCESSING_INSTRUCTION_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify a
[ProcessingInstruction](api:Titanium.XML.ProcessingInstruction) node.

properties.name: text
properties.summary: Content (value) of all text nodes within this node.

properties.name: TEXT_NODE
properties.summary:
Used with [nodeType](api:Titanium.XML.Node#nodeType) to identify a
[Text](api:Titanium.XML.Text) node.

properties.name: textContent
properties.summary: Content (value) of all text nodes within this node.
properties.description:
On Android, `textContent` is supported on [Element](api:Titanium.XML.Element) and
[Text](api:Titanium.XML.Text) nodes only.

methods.name: appendChild
methods.summary: Appends the node `newChild` as a child of this node.
methods.description:
On iOS, `appendChild` is supported on [Element](api:Titanium.XML.Element)
nodes **only**.

methods.name: cloneNode
methods.summary: Returns a duplicate of this node.

parameters.name: deep
parameters.summary: Whether or not to perform a deep copy of this node.

methods.name: hasAttributes
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this node has attributes.

returns.summary: True if this node has attributes, false if it does not.

methods.name: hasChildNodes
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this node has child nodes.

returns.summary: True if this node has children, false if it does not.

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.summary: Inserts the node `newChild` before the node `refChild`.
methods.description:
On iOS, `insertBefore` is supported on [Element](api:Titanium.XML.Element)
nodes **only**.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.summary: Tests whether the DOM implementation supports a specific feature.

returns.summary: True if the feature is supported, false if it is not.

methods.name: normalize
methods.summary: Normalizes text and attribute nodes in this node's child hierarchy.

methods.name: removeChild
methods.summary: Removes a child node from this node.
methods.description:
On iOS, `removeChild` is supported on [Element](api:Titanium.XML.Element)
nodes **only**.

methods.name: replaceChild
methods.summary: Replaces the node `oldChild` with the node `newChild`.
methods.description:
On iOS, `replaceChild` is supported on [Element](api:Titanium.XML.Element)
nodes **only**.
